a.label: Acknowledged, unacknowledged and waived - the three states of a DoD SAP

b.label: Waived unacknowledged special access program (waived USAP)

edges.label: Waived is the terminal state of the taxonomy
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 defines a waived SAP as 'An unacknowledged SAP that has more restrictive reporting and access controls than other unacknowledged SAPs.'

a.label: Carve-Out Provision (DCSA relief from NISP oversight)

b.label: DoD Special Access Program Central Office (DoD SAPCO)

edges.label: DoD SAPCO holds the list of carved-out facilities
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 2 para 2.k requires DoD SAPCO to provide 'DSS confirmation of SAP facilities where the DSS has been carved out of security oversight functions'.

a.label: Carve-Out Provision (DCSA relief from NISP oversight)

b.label: DoDI 5205.11 - Management, Administration, and Oversight of DoD SAPs (12 Sep 2024)

edges.label: Requested on the SAP approval checklist and recorded in the program file
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Appendix 2 to Enclosure 6 item 11.d requires a 'Contract strategy (carve-out justification if applicable)'; Enclosure 7 requires the signed carve-out approval and the list of carved-out facilities in the program record file.

a.label: Cover mechanisms - HVSACO, nicknames, unacknowledged locations

b.label: The annual DoD special access program report to Congress

edges.label: Congress receives nicknames, not missions
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 para 5.d: 'Unclassified nicknames will be used in the annual SAP report to Congress.'

a.label: DoDI 5205.11 - Management, Administration, and Oversight of DoD SAPs (12 Sep 2024)

edges.label: Chairs the deconfliction forum at the DoD SAPCO director level
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 3 para 4.a makes the Director, DoD SAPCO the SSWG Chair, with SAPCO directors from USD(I), USD(P), USD(AT&L), the services, the Joint Staff, DARPA and MDA.

a.label: DoDI 5205.11 - Management, Administration, and Oversight of DoD SAPs (12 Sep 2024)

edges.label: Makes the SRG the working-level body that reviews every waived program annually
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 3 para 3.b(4)-(5): the SRG 'Reviews all waived DoD SAPs annually' and 'Ensures the accuracy of the SAP list submitted to Congress'.

a.label: DoDI 5205.11 - Management, Administration, and Oversight of DoD SAPs (12 Sep 2024)

edges.label: Sets SAPOC membership and its annual validation of the congressional report
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 3 para 2 lists the eighteen SAPOC positions and assigns it 'an annual review and validation of SAP reports sent to the Congressional defense and intelligence committees'.

b.label: The annual DoD special access program report to Congress

edges.label: AARO's search for a concealed program ran against a document AARO did not control
edges.note: The annual SAP report and the waived-program list are produced by cognizant authorities through DoD SAPCO and validated by the SRG and SAPOC; no AARO authority in statute or directive gives it access to the waived list.

edges.label: Unanimous SRG recommendations bypass the SAPOC entirely
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 3 para 3: 'Unanimous recommendations of the SRG may be forwarded directly to the DepSecDef for decision.'

a.label: Waived unacknowledged special access program (waived USAP)

edges.label: Every waived program is reviewed once a year by a named standing body
edges.note: DoDI 5205.11 Enclosure 3 para 3.b(4) assigns the SRG the annual review of all waived DoD SAPs and recommendations on continued waived status.

listedOn.label: The annual DoD special access program report to Congress
